  WHY: On a repo with external approval gates or deployment checks (status=requested), every review run now waits up to CHECK_RUNS_WAIT_TIMEOUT_SECS (default 300s) for check-runs that will never complete because they require human intervention.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py, _build_context_text() line 280 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The incomplete computation changed from "run.get(status) in (queued, in_progress)" to "run.get(status) != completed or run.get(conclusion) is None" is unconditional.
  WHY: Reviewer and consolidator prompts receive incomplete[]. entries for check-runs the old code deliberately ignored, which can mislead reviewers or cause the editor to wait for or address a check controlled by the repo's deployment-gate controls.
- scripts/collect_pr_check_runs_context.py, main() line 428 | severity=low | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The timeout warning still prints "... with {in_flight} check-run(s) still queued/in_progress; proceeding with snapshot." after the wait view now includes more status types.
  WHY: When a review run times out waiting for a requested deployment gate, the log message is misleading.
- scripts/review_autofix_step_claude_fixer_handoff.sh, lines 85-103 (consensus file ledger computation) | severity=high | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The consensus-file ledger validation treats any partially formed or truncated consensus file as ledger_state=missing and hands off to Claude, but this fail-closed behavior is undocumented in the header comment block.
  WHY: A reviewer crash or summariser timeout can leave the PR blocked because the checker sees no valid verdict target.
